Senses.Explanation: Karmic consciousness adrift describes being lost in inherited discriminating activity with no reliable ground. Yinyuan Longqi and Miyun Yuanwu apply it to listeners who cannot present or raise the matter; Wuyi Yuanlai makes failure to understand the immediate condition equivalent to this groundlessness. Changlu Zuzhao provocatively chooses the condition in the marketplace rather than the stylized “rest” he rejects.
